subject.title: fix(line): dripping inbound media downloads hang past setup timeout

question: Should LINE media retrieval remain on current main's `MessagingApiBlobClient` path, or may this fix intentionally replace it with custom fetch and 202 readiness polling?
rationale: The SDK does not expose an obvious timeout or abort parameter, so preserving SDK ownership and preserving the branch's readiness contract cannot both be assumed without an owner decision.

options.title: Preserve the SDK path
options.body: Rebase onto current main, retain `MessagingApiBlobClient`, and implement only the narrowest supported stream deadline or upstream client seam.

options.title: Approve custom HTTP ownership
options.body: Allow the LINE plugin to own direct fetch, 202 polling, cancellation, and error behavior, with explicit tests and live upgrade proof covering the SDK-path replacement.

recommendation.title: Preserve the SDK path
recommendation.body: Rebase onto current main, retain `MessagingApiBlobClient`, and implement only the narrowest supported stream deadline or upstream client seam.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice concerns the repository's plugin and dependency ownership boundary rather than only timer mechanics.
